gemini-2.5-flash.gemini-2.5-flash: Screenplay B demonstrates exceptional fidelity to the source text, including almost verbatim dialogue and comprehensive character descriptions with excellent disambiguation across time periods. gemini-2.5-flash.grok-4.5: This screenplay offers very high adaptation fidelity and strong character clarity, preserving much of the original dialogue and emotional beats. gemini-2.5-flash.claude-sonnet-5: Screenplay D provides an exceptionally faithful adaptation, closely mirroring the source text's dialogue and narrative. Character descriptions are detailed and consistent. gemini-2.5-flash.grok-4: This screenplay suffers from a severe lack of character disambiguation, with most characters lacking distinct visual descriptions, which is a critical flaw for AI casting. gemini-2.5-flash.gpt-4o-mini: Screenplay F is an extremely condensed outline that fails to capture the essence or detail of the source material, resulting in very poor fidelity and dramatic pacing.
